overview_description.description: ReadySet is a distributed SQL caching layer that precomputes the results of parameterized SQL queries and incrementally updates these results as the underlying data changes. It is wire-compatible with MySQL and Postgres, plugs directly into existing databases and applications without any code changes, and elastically scales read throughput to meet fluctuating demands. ReadySet offers the low latencies of a custom caching system and the high query throughputs of read replicas with the straightforward developer experience of using a single relational database.

product.name: Readyset Cache Engine
product.description: A distributed SQL caching engine for PostgreSQL and MySQL that accelerates query performance by caching query results and updating them incrementally without code changes.

product.name: Readyset Cloud
product.description: A fully-managed cloud deployment of Readyset Cache Engine on AWS, offering high availability, enterprise-grade security, and integration with AWS services for scalable SQL caching.

product.name: Readyset Private
product.description: A self-hosted deployment option of Readyset Cache Engine that runs within a customer's own cloud or data center environment, offering customizable resources and enterprise support.
